title: Aging of Prompt Engineering Techniques Across LLM Versions
abstract: arXiv:2608.24641v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prompt engineering and prompt engineering techniques (PETs) have become an integral part of software engineering for AI systems. However, new LLMs are released frequently and it remains unclear how the effectiveness of prompt engineering techniques changes across successive generations of Large Language Models (LLMs). To this end, we conduct a partial replication of the study by Khojah et al. (2025). We evaluate five techniques - Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, Chain-of-Thought (CoT), Contrastive Chain-of-Thought (CCoT), and an adapted version of Program-of-Thought (PoT) - on six instruction-tuned models grouped into three version pairs: GPT-3.5-Turbo/GPT-4o, Qwen2 7B Instruct/Qwen2.5 7B Instruct, and Mistral-7B-Instruct/Mistral-Large. translated_title: 提示工程技巧在LLM版本间的老化现象
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24641v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：提示工程和提示工程技巧（PETs）已成为AI系统软件工程中不可或缺的一部分。然而，新LLM频繁发布，提示工程技巧在不同代际大型语言模型（LLMs）间的有效性变化仍不清楚。为此，我们对Khojah等人（2025）的研究进行了部分复制。我们评估了五种技巧——零样本（Zero-Shot）、少样本（Few-Shot）、思维链（CoT）、对比思维链（CCoT）以及改编版思维程序（PoT）——在六个指令微调模型上，这些模型被分为三个版本对：GPT-3.5-Turbo/GPT-4o、Qwen2 7B Instruct/Qwen2.5 7B Instruct和Mistral-7B-Instruct/Mistral-Large。我们使用CodePromptEval数据集的干净子集，包含218个上下文丰富的Python函数和通过pass@k功能正确性评估的19,620个总生成样本，以评估模型对在函数级代码上的表现。
tldr: 本研究通过复制实验发现，提示工程技巧（如零样本、思维链等）在不同代际LLM间的有效性存在显著变化，部分技巧在新版本中效果下降，揭示了提示工程技巧的“老化”现象。
en_tdlr: This study reveals that prompt engineering techniques exhibit varying effectiveness across LLM generations, with some techniques showing degraded performance in newer versions, highlighting the "aging" phenomenon of these techniques.
